summary: yum_repository options: include external config, includepkgs to whitelist packages, ip_resolve, metadata_expire, metalink and mirrorlist.
questions: How do I only allow certain packages from a repo?
How do I use a mirrorlist instead of baseurl?
How do I force IPv4 for a yum repo?
How do I change metadata expiry?

answer_card.title: yum_repository parameters (part 3)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `includepkgs`: only these packages (globs, `$releasever` ok)
- `mirrorlist`, `metalink`
- `metadata_expire` (default 6h)
- `ip_resolve`: `4`/`IPv4`, `6`/`IPv6`, `whatever`
- `include`: external config file or URL
